I’m sending mom $3k tomorrow.
We really did it.”

Three days later he went all-in on a “sure thing” during NFP.
Wiped the entire account + his personal savings.
$8,400 gone in 47 minutes.

He called me at 3am crying so hard he couldn’t speak.
I told him “It’s just money, we’ll build again.”

He said “I can’t face mom. I can’t face myself.”

Next morning they found him in his room.
Hanging.
With the funded certificate still on the wall behind him.

If you just blew an account and feel like dying tonight…

That certificate means nothing.
That money means nothing.

Your life means everything.

Put the phone down.
Call someone.
Stay here with us.

We need you alive more than we need you rich.
Your account balance is NOT your worth.
Your family doesn’t need a rich son , they need you alive.

Please.
You are loved beyond your P&L.
